name: Drowned Lands and Vanished Seas
description: Oceans that closed, lakes that drained and lands that sank: the lost geography of Earth, from ancient supercontinents to Doggerland and the shrinking Aral Sea.

checkpoints.name: Continents come and go
checkpoints.note: Rodinia, Pannotia and Gondwana gather and break up as oceans such as the Iapetus and the Rheic open and then close for ever.

checkpoints.name: The seas of the dinosaurs
checkpoints.note: Pangaea splits, Tethys closes, a shallow seaway divides North America, the Mediterranean dries and refills, and Lake Pannon fills up with mud.

checkpoints.name: Ice-age lands and lakes
checkpoints.note: As the last ice age ends, giant lakes burst their dams, rising seas flood Doggerland, and a landslide off Norway sends a tsunami across the North Sea.

checkpoints.name: Seas we have lost
checkpoints.note: In the last century a sea has been drained by human hand: the Aral Sea shrank to a fraction of its size when rivers were diverted for farming.
